facts: At recovery start, both the controlled-tab list and user-tab list were empty, and the prior game tab no longer existed.
The incident was classified as environment session-surface loss after a process restart associated with chat clearing.
The recorded recovery opened the game in a new IAB surface at /home, booted to the lobby, and reached a プロデュース再開 dialog.
The resume dialog displayed season 1, one week remaining, 1,169 fans, and the recorded character state.
Those server fields matched the durable boundary, and a later fresh stable WING_HOME observation was persisted.
The recorded reconciliation found no week double-commit and left W8 unconsumed.
inferences: Recovery requires establishing a new browser surface and reopening the game because there is no surviving tab to attach to.
The visible resume dialog is evidence of server-held state but is not by itself permission to resume semantic business actions.
Before semantic business actions resume, server fields must match the durable checkpoint and a fresh stable post-resume state must be observed.
A mismatch, unavailable field, or unstable state requires remaining fail-closed rather than selecting a business objective.
unknowns: The direct mechanism that removed the tabs is unknown.
Whether an action was in flight at the exact restart moment is unknown.
Before reconciliation, the integrity of the server-side business boundary is unknown.
A future reopened session's state is unknown until its own fresh reconciliation.
reason: Total client-surface loss removes continuity evidence; the recorded recovery is safe only as a reconciliation pattern, with server-to-durable agreement and a fresh stable boundary required before business semantics resume.
